growth_signal.value: Plans to double headcount by 2026 and expand globally.

entry.idea: Most cyberattacks start with a tricked employee, so Riot trains staff to spot and stop attacks.
entry.lesson: Fix the human weak point in a system, not just the technology.
entry.name: Riot Security

growth.basis: substitute: Series B larger than earlier funding, plus VivaTech list criteria
growth.reason: Raised a €28.9M Series B and was named to the VivaTech Top 100 Rising Startups, which needs €5M revenue and 40% growth.

market.reason: Every company with staff needs security training, worldwide.

tech.reason: Training software and simulations are solid engineering but can be copied in months.

sources.title: Le français Riot lève 30 millions de dollars
Riot : cybersécurité et levée de fonds à Paris en 2025

entry.twist: It turns employees into a shield through security awareness training instead of selling only tools.
entry.who_pays: Companies pay a subscription to train their employees.
entry.why_now: AI makes phishing and scams more convincing, so firms need staff who can spot them.
